SLBSNSU NCC Instructor Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SLBSNSU NCC Instructor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SLBSNSU NCC Instructor recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. The walk-in interview is scheduled for 04 September 2026. Ensure you reach the venue on time with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the NCC Instructor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be retired army personnel, GCI, or hold an NCC-C certificate to be eligible for the NCC Instructor position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the NCC Instructor position?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 500/- per hour or a maximum of Rs. 25,000/- per month, whichever is less.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the NCC Instructor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the NCC Instructor post at Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri National Sanskrit University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the SLBSNSU NCC Instructor role?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in-Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri National Sanskrit University, New Delhi - 110016.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original certificates and their self-attested photocopies, including ID proof and educational certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type is on a contract basis for the academic session 2026-27.
